targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  avg(a_net_mag) AS "Irradianza"
FROM public.data
WHERE device_uuid = '00000003-0001-0005-0000-000000000001'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
